verdict.rationale: Aider's entire product is built around delegating coding tasks to an LLM assistant via chat commands (/ask, /architect, /run, /test), CLI --message scripting, and a scriptable Python API (coder.run), with community confirming real-world delegation use (codebase Q&A, autonomous 'navigator mode'). Missing for 10: more independent benchmarking of task delegation reliability beyond anecdotal HN comments.
